children: indie Semiconductor (Nasdaq: INDI), an automotive solutions innovator, today announced that it has granted equity awards (the “Inducement Grants”) under its 2023 Inducement Incentive Plan to new employees who joined indie. The grants were previously approved by the Compensation Committee of the Board of Directors of indie Semiconductor. Information regarding the equity awards can be found on the company's investor relations website at:

Headquartered in Aliso Viejo, CA, indie is accelerating ADAS intelligence across automotive, quantum, and Physical AI applications through next-generation hardware, system solutions, and perception software technologies. By developing high-performance, energy-efficient semiconductor, photonic, and software solutions, we are enabling machines to perceive, understand, and interact with the physical world. Spanning radar, computer vision, LiDAR, and ultrasound, our platforms power advanced safety, automation, positioning, and automated capabilities for leading automotive OEMs, intelligent machines, and emerging AI-driven systems worldwide.
